meta.name: pathfinder
meta.description: Map a codebase into feature-grouped flowcharts, identify duplicated concerns across features, and propose a unified architecture. Use when asked to "find the ideal path," unify duplicated systems, or audit architecture before a refactor. Emits a proposed unified flowchart plus per-system /make-plan prompts.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将代码库映射为功能流程图，识别重复并统一架构
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在重构或统一多个重复系统
copy.tagline_en: Map codebase into feature flowcharts, identify duplicates, and unify architecture
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are refactoring or unifying duplicated systems

howto.what: Claude 会把代码库拆成按功能分组的 Mermaid 流程图,标出跨功能的重复逻辑,并提出统一架构方案。产出存在 PATHFINDER-日期目录里的流程图、重复报告和可复制到 /make-plan 的提示词,不写实现代码。
howto.when: 当你要找“理想路径”、统一重复的系统,或在重构前审计架构时接管。

say.text: 帮我把这个代码库按功能拆开,画出流程图
say.note: 先生成 00-features.md,再按功能输出流程图

say.text: 找出各功能之间重复的逻辑,给我一份重复报告
按统一方案给我可以直接交给 /make-plan 的提示词

howto.what_en: Claude maps the repo into feature-grouped Mermaid flowcharts, flags duplicated concerns, and proposes a unified architecture. It writes flowcharts, a duplication report, a proposal, and `/make-plan` prompts in `PATHFINDER-<date>/`.
howto.when_en: It takes over when you ask to "find the ideal path," unify duplicated systems, or audit architecture before a refactor.

say_en.text: Map this codebase into per-feature flowcharts.
Find duplicated logic across features and report it.
Give me the /make-plan prompts for the unified design.
